questions.question_text: What is digital content creation primarily about?

options.text: Creating videos, photos, or posts to share online
Playing video games without recording them

correct_answer.text: Creating videos, photos, or posts to share online

questions.question_text: Which platform is best suited for short, trendy videos lasting 15-60 seconds?
Why is identifying a niche important for a digital content creator?

options.text: It helps you use every platform at once
It makes your content stand out and builds a loyal following
It ensures you never have to learn new skills
It guarantees you’ll make money immediately

correct_answer.text: It makes your content stand out and builds a loyal following

questions.question_text: What is an ethical consideration when creating digital content?

options.text: Using any music or video clip you like without permission
Sharing personal information about others without consent
Spreading unverified information to gain views
